notes.text: 8 trees, 10 illuminated posts and 6 planted edge details turn the plinth into a complete public setting. Colossal Duck Float is a 3D voxel solid 1,862 stud columns across and 36 courses tall, laid as 22,981 cross-bonded brick cells on a 96 x 68-stud scene. The two-layer foundation cross-bonds every row into one editable, stable model.
